warnings: This page is a municipal directory (City of Taunton), not one camp's own material. It lists at least 8 separate programs from different operators. Each one should be its own listing, built from that operator's site.
Old season: the page covers summer 2026, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is shown.

Programs listed: BGCMS Camp Greenside (31 Court St, indoor, ages 5-18, M-F 7:30am-5:30pm, 7 weeks from July 6, 2026, https://www.bgcmetrosouth.org/camp-greenside); BGCMS Camp Riverside (outdoor, ages 5-15, from June 29, 2026, https://www.bgcmetrosouth.org/campriverside); Girls Inc. (7 weeks, girls 5-14); Old Colony YMCA Camp Taunton (trip-based, ages 5-13, from June 29, 2026, contact jtowne@oldcolonyymca.org); Taunton Parks & Rec Summer Festival at Hopewell Park (ages 5-12, from July 6, 2026, marked full, https://tauntonma.myrec.com); Tennis Lessons (ages 10+, July 6-Aug 3); Summer Track Series (ages 3+, June 24-July 15); T.O.G.E.T.H.E.R. Summer Program (ages 6+, from July 1, 2026, together@truecollective.org).
The 15 Summer St address and the 508-821-1000 phone number belong to Taunton City Hall, not to any camp, so they were not recorded as camp contact details.
unknowns: Which single camp this listing should represent. Pick one program and use its own website.
